name: South West Queensland Pipeline
description: Carries Cooper Basin gas from Ballera east to the Wallumbilla hub, historically the main link between Cooper Basin (SA/QLD) supply and the Queensland east coast market.

name: Ballera to Moomba QSN Link
description: Connects the Ballera/SWQP corridor in the Cooper Basin (QLD) to the Moomba hub (SA), the critical link that ties the Queensland network (SWQP, QGP, RBP) into the rest of the NEM (MSP, MAP, EGP).

name: Queensland Gas Pipeline
description: Runs north from the Wallumbilla area through Rolleston and Banana to the Gladstone/Curtis Island LNG precinct.

name: Roma Brisbane Pipeline
description: Delivers gas from the Wallumbilla hub east to Brisbane, passing through Dalby and Oakey, the primary supply route for South East Queensland.

name: Moomba Sydney Pipeline
description: Carries Cooper Basin gas from Moomba to the Sydney market, one of the two original NEM east coast trunk lines. Terminates at Wilton, Jemena's actual receipt point (confirmed via Jemena's own network documentation), rather than continuing on to a separate downstream location.

name: Moomba Adelaide Pipeline
description: Carries Cooper Basin gas from Moomba south to Adelaide.

name: Eastern Gas Pipeline
description: Connects Gippsland Basin gas from Longford, Victoria, to Sydney, providing a second supply route into NSW independent of the Cooper Basin. Terminates at Horsley Park, itself the delivery point for the Sydney STTM (confirmed via Jemena's own pipeline documentation) rather than continuing on to a separate downstream location.

name: Tasmanian Gas Pipeline
description: Subsea pipeline carrying Gippsland Basin gas under Bass Strait from Longford to Bell Bay, Tasmania, Tasmania's only mainland gas connection.

name: Wallumbilla Lateral (PPL 90)
description: Pipeline licence lateral linking the Wallumbilla hub trading points into the SWQP/QGP corridor.

name: QGC Lateral (PPL 133)
description: Pipeline licence lateral connecting the QGC-operated Curtis Island LNG project into the Brisbane-area network.

name: APLNG Lateral (PPL 134)
description: Pipeline licence lateral connecting the APLNG Curtis Island project into the Wallumbilla hub.

name: SEA Gas Pipeline
description: Carries gas from the Otway Basin (via Iona) in Victoria west to Adelaide, giving South Australia an alternative supply source to the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline.

name: Victoria-NSW Interconnect
description: Interconnects the Victorian and NSW/Sydney gas networks via a chain of compressor stations, allowing gas to flow either direction between the two markets.

name: South West Pipeline (Otway-Melbourne)
description: Delivers Otway Basin gas from the Iona storage/processing hub to the Melbourne network.

name: Yellowbank Lateral
description: Feeds Yellowbank field gas into the Rolleston junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Fairview Lateral
description: Feeds Fairview field gas into the Rolleston junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Rockhampton Lateral
description: Regional demand lateral off the Banana junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Gladstone Lateral
description: Regional demand lateral off the Banana junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Wide Bay Lateral
description: Regional demand lateral off the Banana junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Scotia/Peat Lateral
description: Real route runs from Condamine (on RBP) to the Scotia/Peat gas fields, not directly to Wallumbilla.

name: Berwyndale Lateral
description: Feeds Berwyndale field gas into the Wallumbilla hub area.

name: Talinga Lateral
description: Feeds Talinga field gas into the Wallumbilla hub area.

name: Braemar Lateral
description: Supplies the Braemar 1 and 2 power stations off the Windibri junction on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline.

name: Toowoomba Lateral
description: Regional demand lateral off the Roma Brisbane Pipeline network.

name: Young to Wagga Wagga Lateral
description: Regional lateral off the Moomba Sydney Pipeline at Young, serving the Riverina region toward Wagga Wagga.

name: Junee to Griffith Lateral
description: Extends the Riverina gas network from the Wagga Wagga/Junee area west to Griffith.

name: Young to Lithgow Lateral
description: Regional lateral off the Moomba Sydney Pipeline at Young, serving the Central Tablelands toward Lithgow.

name: Orange Spur
description: Spur off the Young to Lithgow lateral serving Orange.

name: Central West Pipeline
description: Regional pipeline extending the NSW gas network from the Young/Wagga Wagga area west to Dubbo.

name: Central Ranges Pipeline
description: Regional pipeline extending the NSW gas network from Dubbo north to Tamworth.

name: Dalton to Canberra Lateral
description: One of MSP's four laterals, branching off the mainline at Dalton to serve Canberra.

name: Carpentaria Gas Pipeline
description: Connects the Cooper Basin at Ballera to the Mount Isa mining region in north-west Queensland, commissioned 1998.

name: Cannington Lateral
description: Lateral off the Carpentaria Gas Pipeline serving the Cannington mine.

name: Port Pirie Lateral
description: Lateral off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP) mainline serving Port Pirie.

name: Whyalla Lateral
description: Lateral off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP) mainline serving Whyalla.

name: Angaston Lateral
description: Lateral off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP) mainline serving Angaston in the Barossa Valley.
